title: Equivalence induced by coordinate permutation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a set, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of the $n$ coordinate positions. Reindexing functions from those positions to $\Omega$ by $i\mapsto\sigma(i)$ defines a bijection, whose inverse reindexes by $\sigma^{-1}$.
